title: AXIAL / FOCUS STACK
hypothesis: A stack of unequal cyclic indices aligned to one fixed focus can make multi-dimensional state faster to orient and traverse while preserving source identity across ring and strip projections.
evidence: FIELD adapter reads the actual showcase manifest
HOUSE adapter reads the actual public spatial model
ring cardinalities are derived from source vocabularies rather than forced to four
drag/release snap transfers the recovered FOLD//BLOOM focus-ring mechanic
RING and STRIP render the same selected indices
focus result can align rings back to an exact source identity
0.6.1 removes the explanatory primer from the active surface and transfers the recovered Fold//Bloom bright-gate / drag-release-snap visual grammar into the primary interaction.
promotion_gate: Remain PROOF_REQUIRED. First collect ordinary use evidence from FIELD/HOUSE navigation; only then compare against a plain faceted/search surface. Physical cylinder work is deferred until a useful software ring composition earns embodiment.
research_question: Can one focus spine across unequal cyclic vocabularies reduce reorientation cost while preserving exact source identity and a return path?
known_gap: No comparative usability evidence yet. HOUSE is a public-safe static model, not live state or actuation. The physical cylinder remains unvalidated and is no longer a prerequisite for software utility.

current_classification.basis: 0.6.1 is a bounded interface convergence pass: less explanation, larger instrument, one obvious gesture, source-aware focus, same 0.6 data law.
